name: Process: Run the capture review with failure typing, and the count by type at the leads' review
markdown_description:
P28 and I4, with row 145. At every capture review off the floor the reviewing lead types the failure on the process update as basic, complex, or intelligent, names the process and the mechanism, names the reviewing lead's seat as the fix's owner, re-writes any capture that names a person as cause into process, and holds any post-mortem as a process conversation; the count by type per period joins item 1 of the leads' review beside the capture rate; a count by person is never read; the non-negotiable breach is never typed; a basic failure recurring on the same seat across the recurrence thresholds with the placement fixed is the hand-off shape to the check-in; an intelligent failure corrected as an error goes to the leads' review as a tight-edge entry on the mechanism. Extends `86akh6779`, `86akh5uk4`, and `86akhpuqr` by reference. High.
